name: Primordial Blast comes back from an Elemental Mastery transform without a New Spell Learned toast
contract: SetTemporarySpellReplacement swaps the client's bars with SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL, and the client announces the spell it swaps in as learned when that spell's SpellCustomAttr row carries the notable bit 0x400 (Extensions.dll, OnSupersededSpell -> OnSpellLearned -> NOTABLE_SPELL_LEARNED, which the 'New Spell Learned' toast answers). mod-spellbook sets that bit for every Book of Ascension spell, and Primordial Blast 800732 (row 24836) carries it. An Elemental Mastery transform (Ignis 713003) stands 712668 in for 800732, and the swap back whenever the transform ends announced Primordial Blast as newly learned, whether it expired or the elemental cast consumed it. The swap notice must arrive with 800732 muted (its row pushed with the bit cleared just before it) and the row restored right after, and no learned-spell packet may announce it, so only a genuine learn of Primordial Blast draws the toast. spellbook_loud_supersedes_for counts notices that swapped 800732 in while the client still held it notable; spellbook_client_notable reads the bit of the last row pushed for it; spellbook_learned_alerts counts learned-spell packets.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
Worn Shortsword in the main hand
Worn Dagger in the off hand
SETUP: learning Primordial Blast is a genuine learn the client was told about
Elemental Mastery transforms Primordial Blast into Ignis
Ignis supersedes Primordial Blast
The transform expires
Primordial Blast comes back
SETUP: the client was told Primordial Blast came back
An expiring transform hands Primordial Blast back muted
Global cooldown
Elemental Mastery transforms Primordial Blast again
Ignis supersedes Primordial Blast
Primordial Blast as Ignis
SETUP: Ignis strikes in place of Primordial Blast
Primordial Blast comes back
SETUP: the client was told Primordial Blast came back
A consumed transform hands Primordial Blast back muted
No swap announced Primordial Blast as learned
Primordial Blast is notable again, so a genuine learn is still announced
Every pushed row carried the row id the client's own table holds for it
